reviews.text: Worst app i have experience so far …they didn’t even refund my money …dont ever order from HnM app … worst customer service and refund policy…its been one month I didn’t got my refund

I really miss the previous H&M app.

The new design makes shopping much harder instead of easier. It’s now difficult to find specific items, categories, or filters, and browsing feels confusing. I spend much more time looking for products and often end up giving up instead of buying something.

The previous version was simple, intuitive, and focused on shopping. The new interface feels like it’s prioritizing visual design over usability.

I’m clearly not the only one who feels this way—many users have shared similar feedback since the redesign. Instead of encouraging shopping, the new experience is actually discouraging purchases.

As a loyal customer, I honestly find myself buying less because of the new app. Please consider bringing back the simpler navigation and making it easier to browse and find products.

reviews.title: Worst customer care service
reviews.text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ (1 Star)

This has been one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever had.

I requested a return for my H&M order over 15 days ago, and no one has come to pick it up. Since then, I’ve been calling customer support repeatedly. Every single time, I’m forced to wait on hold for 30 minutes or more just to speak to someone.

The customer service representatives are completely unhelpful. They keep repeating the same scripted response: “We’re looking into it” or “We’ve escalated your case.” But nothing actually happens. No updates, no resolution, and no pickup.

It’s incredibly frustrating that customers have to waste so much time with no outcome. If you offer a return service, you should be able to complete it within a reasonable timeframe.

This experience has completely destroyed my trust in H&M’s customer support. Shopping is easy, but when you need help, you’re left waiting endlessly with no accountability.

I sincerely hope H&M improves its customer service because the current experience is unacceptable.

Instead of the jeans I ordered, I received a wrong item (a top). I returned the item and clearly informed your team that I did not want a refund; I wanted the jeans that I originally ordered. Now I am being told that the returned item does not belong to my order. If that is the case, then how was the same item delivered to me in the first place? This appears to be an error in your warehouse or delivery process, and it is unfair to hold the customer responsible for it.

1. Process the full refund for the item that was not delivered correctly, or
2. Deliver the jeans that I originally ordered.

If this issue is not resolved promptly, I will be compelled to escalate the matter by filing a complaint with the National Consumer Helpline and the Consumer Commission.

Please treat this as my final request and provide a written

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text:
This is an absolute scam and customer should be extremely careful when using H&M.
The price displayed on product pages are not the prices charged in the cart. For example, a kids dress was listed for $6 on the product page but became $8 in the cart. 
What makes this even worse is that customer support is fully aware of the issue. Instead of fixing the problem, they simply suggest placing the order and contacting them afterward to receive a refund for the difference. In other words, they have no intention of correcting a pricing error that directly affects customers at checkout.
Displaying one price and charging another is unacceptable and feels deceptive. Customers should carefully verify every price in their cart before completing a purchase.

reviews.title: Refund Issue
reviews.text:
Hello,

I have been shopping with H&M for the past four years and recently started using the app and delivery services. However, I am extremely disappointed with my current experience.

For the past month, I have been trying to get clarity on why my refund has not been processed, even though I returned the product. I have contacted customer service multiple times, but I keep receiving the same response that the matter is “still under investigation,” without any proper explanation.

I have returned products many times in the past, and this is the first time I am experiencing such a significant delay and lack of clarity.

To explain the situation: I ordered a dress, did not like it, and returned it. After several days, I was informed that a different product was received instead. I immediately requested an investigation, but there has been no clear update since then—only repeated emails stating that the issue is still in process.

At this point, I am unsure what went wrong during the return pickup. I request you to kindly look into this matter urgently and provide a clear and detailed response regarding my refund.

reviews.title: H&m used to provide good service but now it is the worst.
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the service. I placed an order on 21st February, and it has still not been delivered even after more than 15 days. There has been no update or progress on the shipment.

I have contacted customer support multiple times, but every time they simply ask me to wait another 24 hours. This has been happening for the past 5 days, with no real solution or information provided.

This level of delay and lack of proper customer support is very frustrating. I expected much better service and transparency regarding my order. I hope this issue is addressed immediately and steps are taken to improve customer support and delivery reliability.
I’ve faced this issue multiple times now. If there was a lower rating than 1 star I would give it to h&m
